chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Abstention from sin is easier than seeking forgiveness afterwards.
ai.seo_question: Why is avoiding sin better than seeking forgiveness?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes that the discipline required to prevent sin is superior to the effort needed for post-facto repentance, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on *al-wara'* (scrupulousness) as a proactive spiritual shield. This maxim underscores the practical wisdom of cultivating a habit of righteousness, thereby avoiding the spiritual vulnerability and potential complications associated with the repentance process.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 170. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Abstention from sin is easier than seeking forgiveness afterwards. [1]
